description: Implementation of TaxReadPlatformService for retrieving tax component and group data from the database, including mapping database rows to data objects and providing lookup templates.

classes.name: TaxReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to retrieve tax components and groups, including mapping database results to data objects.

classes.name: TaxComponentMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set rows to TaxComponentData objects, including handling of tax component history data.

classes.name: TaxComponentHistoryDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax component history data from SQL result set.

classes.name: TaxGroupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set rows to TaxGroupData objects, including associated tax components.

classes.name: TaxGroupMappingsDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax group component associations.

classes.name: TaxComponentLookUpMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax component lookup data.

classes.name: TaxGroupLookUpMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax group lookup data.

methods.name: retrieveAllTaxComponents
methods.description: Retrieves all tax components from the database.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentData
methods.description: Retrieves specific tax component data by ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or editing tax components.

methods.name: retrieveAllTaxGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all tax groups from the database.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupData
methods.description: Retrieves specific tax group data by ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a tax group with its components for editing.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or editing tax groups.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentsForLookUp
methods.description: Retrieves tax components for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupsForLookUp
methods.description: Retrieves tax groups for lookup purposes.
